newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco B dips 5.16 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Meralco B dips 5.16 pct in late trade.

text.p: Manila Electric Corp B shares, the most heavily-traded issue on Tuesday, fell eight pesos or 5.16 percent to 147 pesos in late trade as investors decided to cash in earlier gains, brokers said.
"Meralco B was among the issues that soared on the peso depreciation news. There is profit-taking and a bit of panic-selling," said Noel Reyes, vice-president at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc.
Meralco A share was also lower by one peso at 84.50 in late session.
Some 157.18 million pesos worth of Meralco B shares, which are open to foreigners, and 5.16 million worth of A shares changed hands in late trade.
